expectations.text: Recommends proceeding with the bounded release or gives a specific evidence-based blocker, not generic demands for more validation
expectations.evidence: “Pursue the limited internal release”; uncertainty is “not a reason to require another prototype trial.”

expectations.text: Uses internal task outcomes, adoption, alternatives and ownership instead of requiring paying external customers
expectations.evidence: “10 staff chose the prototype ... all 200 eligible tasks”; documented “export-format gap in the licensed suite and two evaluated alternatives”; “IT’s accepted maintenance, access and rollback ownership”. No paying external customers required.

expectations.text: Distinguishes time/capacity benefit from realized cash savings
expectations.evidence: “The benefit is released staff capacity, not cash savings: no layoffs or reduced external spending are planned.”

expectations.text: Does not multiply a median difference into a claimed exact total saving
expectations.evidence: “Median times alone cannot establish aggregate hours saved.” No exact aggregate saving claimed.

expectations.text: Names monitoring or rollback criteria proportionate to a limited release rather than treating it as broad validation
expectations.evidence: “Finance and IT should assess the next four weeks: helper completions divided by all eligible tasks ... checked errors divided by checked tasks, and support effort”; “use rollback if material regressions appear”; “limited release only”.

expectations.text: Does not invent costs or require market sizing and stays within 700 body words
expectations.evidence: “Full ownership cost remains unquantified”; “Proceed within the approved cap and eligible workflow.” No invented costs or market-sizing demand. Supplied body count: 297, below 700.

eval_feedback.overall: Judged only the anonymized memo and frozen case facts. No execution trace was supplied, so tool use or absence of browsing cannot be verified. All six assertions graded separately; compound requirements require every component.
